name: Tale of Avamphil
source:
There's this land, so far away that the Stars are different, where strange people wander and cosmic beings are the ones that create the line of time.

All purpose for each and everyone is found someway there.

Welcome to Avamphil!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221114151257/https://maraagan.itch.io/tale-of-avamphil]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那里有一片遥远得星辰异样的土地，奇怪的人们在这里徘徊，宇宙的存在创造了时间的线。

每个人的所有目的都可以在那里找到。

欢迎来到阿瓦菲尔！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221114151257/https://maraagan.itch.io/tale-of-avamphil]Itch.io[/url]]
